description: Defines the ProjectionSpace class used for representing and transforming geometrical spaces in the Android SurfaceFlinger composition engine, including methods for computing transformations between spaces with different orientations and bounds.

classes.name: ProjectionSpace
classes.description: Represents a geometrical space with bounds, content rectangle, and orientation, providing methods to compute transformations between spaces.

methods.name: getTransform
methods.description: Computes a transformation matrix that maps this ProjectionSpace's content to a destination ProjectionSpace, considering orientation and bounds.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two ProjectionSpace instances based on bounds, content, and orientation.

methods.name: setBounds
methods.description: Sets the bounds of the ProjectionSpace.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content rectangle of the ProjectionSpace.

methods.name: setOrientation
methods.description: Sets the orientation of the ProjectionSpace.

methods.name: getBoundsAsRect
methods.description: Returns the bounds as a Rect object.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the size bounds of the space.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Returns the current orientation of the space.
